name: ContainerPreview
author: XuanDiNa
description: Hold Left Alt to preview world containers with native item icons. Supports exact Bedrock 1.26.45.01, 1.26.51.01 and 1.26.52.03. Includes permitted background opening, your own Ender Chest and experimental Hive death-crate support. Retains the three-version user-tested test31 DLL.
